title: Finch Circle Care Desk Schedule — Lapse Cut on a Courtesy Reissue
content:
**Schedule.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy lapse cut is 7 days when the note lapsed 21 or more calendar days before the request date, 3 days when it lapsed 11 to 20 days before, and 0 otherwise.

The day the note lapsed is the date of its lapse entry in the membership's note history (the lapse for validity ended); the calendar days are counted from that day to the request date.

| Calendar days from the lapse to the request date | Courtesy lapse cut |
|---|---|
| 21 or more | 7 days |
| 11 to 20 | 3 days |
| 10 or fewer | 0 |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical)

Note lapsed on 1 May: a request on 11 May (10 days) cuts 0; on 12 May (11 days) 3; on 21 May (20 days) 3; on 22 May (21 days) 7.
